# contract

```go
import "github.com/herooftimeandspace/aeries-sis-sdk-golang/contract"
```

Package contract exposes the vendored Aeries documentation manifest used by the SDK.

The manifest lets callers inspect which endpoints, versions, and request parameters the current SDK snapshot knows about without reading internal files directly. That is useful for diagnostics, tests, and onboarding.
